text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the pack heads into the final 
straight—!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Chrono-san's passion— No, but—I won't 
back down!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp*...――!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "I... lost— I couldn't... get it...!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aaah! I was... so close...!
(WOOOOOOOO...!)

"Total goosebumps!" "What an incredible 
race!" "Bouquet, so close!" "Chrono too!" 
"Our generation really is strong! We 
haven't lost!!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...A great radiance――

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ... It's frustrating... It really is...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Chrono-san—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
B-But strangely enough... frustration 
isn't the only thing filling my heart.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The race woven together by all of us had 
the entire racetrack engulfed in pure 
fever pitch...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
We have surely proven the strength of our 
generation. It is all thanks to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even now, this heart still burns with 
passion. To seize victory next time, no 
matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I, too—am glad I got to run with you, 
Chrono-san. Next time, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I will be sure to hold onto those 
feelings and cherish them forever, too—"

"Though she narrowly missed out on the 
Shuka Sho, together with Chrono Genesis, 
they delivered a race worthy of proving 
their generation's tremendous strength!"
...But—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Today's guest is this person!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Here with us is Chrono Genesis, who not 
only competes in the Twinkle Series 
herself, but also possesses a profound 
knowledge of racing!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um... thank you so much. I look forward to 
working with you...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Today, together with Chrono-san, we'll 
unravel the history of the race!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A grand pattern woven from the warp and 
weft of time... I believe that is what 
racing history is.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why... I, too, wish to 
create historic drama and leave behind... 
my own hoofprints."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"With so many Tiara route Umamusume 
achieving great success lately, the racing 
world has reached a turning point."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If there's something new I can depict 
within all that— perhaps it lies in the 
Grand Prix races, like the Arima Kinen and 
Takarazuka Kinen, where runners carry the 
hopes and dreams of their fans.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(She's been performing remarkably ever 
since the 'Shuka Sho'.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(TV, social media, racing 
magazines—there's just too much to keep 
track of...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...Just as I thought. I couldn't draw the 
public's attention.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...No, but there's a next time. I'm sure 
everything will be fine.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Run, run, run all the way through. If I 
do, then even I should be able to shine a 
light on him.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Run, run, run all the way through. If I 
do, then even I should be able to shine a 
light on her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep pushing, there's still so 
much more in me—!

Some time has passed since the Shuka Sho, 
and I discussed our upcoming racing 
rotation with her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is... the Kyoto 
Kinen, is it?

This is the kickoff to her spring GⅠ 
campaign. The competition is top-notch, 
and the 2,200-meter distance should play 
right into her running style.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please. I look forward to working 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Um, I was just thinking about how I'd 
like to stand on many big stages from now 
on.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
First, in the upcoming race—the exhibition 
match— I really want to deliver solid 
results.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In that high-profile race. I want to add a 
single piece, like a cast-iron leaf— 
something to support and strengthen the 
bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And so, I want to build momentum and take 
on the Senior Year...!
choice_data_list:
I see. ...Alright, let's keep giving it 
our all!

I see. ...All right, let's keep doing our 
best from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes—!

—...I fondly recall the sight of her 
saying those words.

—I opened UmaTube. The special feature on 
the Shuka Sho Umamusume popped up right 
away.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
"By the way, what is your dream, 
Bouquet-san?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: To present a golden bouquet to Trainer <username>.

Divided equally among the other runners, 
Curren Bouquetd'or's dream drifted away.

"Even the interviewer praised it as a 
heartfelt dream showing their strong bond. 
However—"

An exclusive interview video was not 
arranged.

She didn't captivate people's hearts or 
spark fiery enthusiasm the way Loves Only 
You or Chrono Genesis did.

Her dream itself is noble and wonderful. 
Which is precisely why, if there's a 
reason for this—
choice_data_list:
(Is it because the one at the center of 
that dream is a nobody like me...?)

(Is it because the one at the center of 
that dream is a nobody like me...?)

text_block_list.text:
If it was meant to be dedicated to a more 
prominent, first-rate veteran Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a bouquet of flowers for Trainer, you 
say!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
He who has guided so many renowned 
Umamusume... I am eager to see what kind 
of bouquet his newest student will 
assemble!

Wasn't she meant to bask in even more 
light?

Just like Chrono Genesis and Loves Only 
You.

Could it be that she was able to run true 
to herself, and on top of that, shine even 
brighter?
...I brush aside the creeping anxiety.

I signed a contract knowing her dream. In 
that case, it's my responsibility to help 
her pursue it head-on.
choice_data_list:
(Let's get results in the exhibition 
match)

text_block_list.text:
"Let's lead her to victory there. We will 
pave a path of glory leading into the 
Senior class."
